name: claude-arad
description: A starter Claude Code marketplace. Add your own plugins and ship them with automated versioning.

plugins.name: base-plugin
plugins.description: Base plugin for your marketplace. Ships the skill-creator skill, plus a sample hook to replace with your own.

plugins.name: garden
plugins.description: Explicit commands for any git repo that has or is a knowledge base: init, survey, tend, maintain, review, capture, restructure, dream.

plugins.name: likec4
plugins.description: C4 architecture models in LikeC4 that stay true to the code: evidence rules, fact-gathering, drift maintenance and review, plus the LikeC4 MCP server for querying the model.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Context management across sessions: carryout writes a self-contained handoff prompt so a fresh Claude can resume the work.

plugins.name: likec4-dsl
plugins.description: Upstream LikeC4 DSL and CLI syntax skill, tracked from likec4/likec4 main.
